title: SOM write-path audit
verified: feature-extraction-orchestrator calls somClusterer.cluster and then materializeToPostgres in apply mode only
som-clustering performs one Postgres UPDATE per assignment and increments updated after each awaited update call
findings: There is no explicit zero-update guard in materializeToPostgres
There is no rowcount check on the update call before incrementing updated
Dry-run mode skips writes by branching, but it does not establish read-only transaction semantics
Success is still implicit: no thrown error plus failed === 0
todo: Inspect the UPDATE return value and enforce rowCount > 0 where supported
Add a terminal guard that fails the run when updated === 0 in apply mode
Convert dry-run to a read-only transaction or equivalent explicit no-write proof
Run a bounded smoke case and confirm write/readback parity

unresolved: whether the current database state already reflects valid SOM assignments
unsafe_constraints: treating a branch-based dry-run as a write-proof
not_yet_proven: the materializer fails when nothing is persisted
the apply path is operationally safe under silent no-op conditions
status.next_safe_action: patch the materializer to fail closed on zero successful updates, then rerun a bounded smoke test
